test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: M and N together can complete a work in 18 days, N and P in 26 days, and M and P in 14 days. Find the approximate number of days in which everyone working together completes the work.
solution:
__Given:__

M and N together can complete a work in 18 days

M and P together can complete a work in 14 days.

N and P together can complete a work in 26 days

__Concept__: 

Work/Days = efficiency 

**Calculation**

 
 

 
 Time
 Total work(LCM of 18,14 and 26)
 Efficiency
 
 

 M + N
 18
 1638
 91
 
 

 M + P
 14
 117
 
 

 N + P
 26
 63
 
 

 

Total efficiency = 91 + 117 + 63 = 271

Total time taken together = 1638/271/2

= 3276/271 = 12 days approx.

**The answer is 12 days.**
